mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during easing periods, or FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market stress, reducing investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such rate increases, or returns remain positive despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a healthy macroeconomic environment, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite simultaneous increases in both proxies.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising CPIAUCSL coupled with persistently low FEDFUNDS rates signals accommodative monetary policy and inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in late-cycle periods despite the CPIAUCSL-FEDFUNDS interaction.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in PAYEMS above 100,000 in three months reflects robust labor market growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during such labor surges, or returns remain negative despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in RSAFS (demand) alongside a decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals a contractionary monetary policy reversal, stimulating economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the RSAFS-FEDFUNDS interaction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) index reflects robust production growth, enhancing corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of high INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, low UNRATE coupled with persistently low FEDFUNDS rates signals improved labor market conditions and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in post-shock regimes despite the UNRATE-FEDFUNDS interaction.
